Record Class Session

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
global.thalion.ttio.workbench.sessions.Session
public record Session(String sessionId, String status, String project, String owner, String engineIdentifier, long startedAt, Integer hostPort, Integer pid, String containerId, String workingDir, Long readyAt, Long lastSeenAt, Long terminatedAt, Integer exitCode, String errorMessage, String image, List<String> command, Map<String,String> env, Map<String,String> bindMounts) extends Record
A session as returned by GET /v1/sessions{,/{id}}.

Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.workbench.sessions.Session. State machine: starting -> running -> terminating -> terminated | failed.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
